description: This file contains unit tests for the DataElement and related classes in the Thunder project, using Google Test framework. It tests data manipulation, linked data elements, and data parser functionalities.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: A class for managing data buffers, supporting copy, size, buffer access, and validation.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: A class representing a data element with methods for CRC calculation, copying, size management, and data access.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A class for linked data elements supporting nested structures and buffer management.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: A class for parsing DataElement objects, supporting validation and byte skipping.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Accesses the buffer of the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within DataElement data.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number at a specified position in DataElement.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within DataElement.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific offset in DataElement.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns DataElement data to a specific boundary.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Gets or sets the enclosed linked data element.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes in the parser.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the parser or data is valid.

search-terms: unit test for core data classes
